frontend: retro-run (writes saves as RetroArch does), via work/msx/make-save-x.py: content copied into the run directory
note: fMSX writes cartridge SRAM to <ROM path without extension>.sav beside the ROM (location content-dir), not in the save directory, on unload; RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM is not used for it, so RetroArch writes no .srm. system/CMOS.ROM is the RTC/CMOS (fMSX default mode MSX2+), written into the system directory on unload. Port 0 device set to 3 (3 = Keyboard, 257 = Joystick + Emulated Keyboard) with work/msx/retro-run-x.
